title: Admin
subtitle: Server & content administration
images_subtitle: The platform image whitelist. Only enabled images can back a new server. You can add external images or delete unwanted images from the whitelist.
delete_image_title: Remove this image from the whitelist?
delete_image_desc: New servers can no longer be created from
cancel_build_desc: The build stops now and pushes nothing:
builds_subtitle: History of image build jobs and trigger controls. The build pod runs inside an isolated namespace with automated Trivy scans.
dockerfile_audit_hint: Archived on the build row for audit. Kaniko executes the `Dockerfile` inside the context tarball — this text is never executed.
download_context_hint: Downloads the uploaded context (.tar.gz) — it contains the Dockerfile that will actually be executed.
context_sha256_hint: Approval pins this digest. Builds reject subsequent uploads that do not match it. Use sha256sum to verify downloaded files during offline review.
context_sha256_missing: No build context is available, or it predates digest recording. The submitter must upload it again.
context_sha256_downloaded: The digest matches the downloaded file. Approval pins this content.
context_sha256_stale: The downloaded version ({{digest}}…) was replaced by a new upload. Download and review the latest version.
approve_needs_context: Nothing to approve: the context has not been uploaded, or must be uploaded again
build_queued_hint: The concurrent build limit ([registry] max_concurrent_builds) has been reached. The task starts automatically after a running build completes.
no_builds_hint: Submit an image build task using the build form.
no_images_hint: The whitelist is empty — a platform admin must add one (CLI for now).
submissions_subtitle: Review queue for user-uploaded modpacks. Approved submissions will automatically trigger safe Kaniko builds with Trivy scans.
reject_dialog_desc: Please provide a detailed reason for rejecting this modpack submission. This reason will be shown to the user.
no_submissions_hint: There are currently no pending or reviewed modpack submissions.
updates_subtitle: Check database backup freshness, review available versions, and set a maintenance window. Run `felis update` on the host to inspect a target; only an explicit `--apply` installs it.
updates_window_advisory: Apply is allowed inside this window. The host checks it before taking a backup and again before installation. Outside the window, apply is refused unless `--now` explicitly starts manual maintenance; `--force` does not bypass the checks.
updates_current_unset: No maintenance window set. Configure one before applying, or explicitly use `--apply --now` for manual maintenance.
updates_validation_both: Both start and end times must be set, or both cleared.
updates_validation_order: End time must be strictly after start time.
updates_timezone_hint: Times are selected and displayed in your browser's local time zone ({{tz}}).
dbbackup_subtitle: The control-plane database stores users, Passkeys, server ownership, quotas, audit logs, and world archive indexes. felis-db-backup.timer performs daily backups, and a separate snapshot is created before upgrade migrations.
dbbackup_stale_title: The newest backup is more than {{hours}} hours old
dbbackup_daily_stale_title: The daily backup last completed {{when}}, past the {{hours}}-hour limit
dbbackup_daily_never_title: The daily timer has not completed a backup
dbbackup_daily_fix_hint: The newer backup was created manually or by another task and is available for restoration. It does not confirm that the daily timer is healthy. Run a daily backup on the host and inspect the timer logs:
dbbackup_servers_title: The newest backup lacks the server definitions
dbbackup_servers_hint: The cluster did not respond during backup, so server definitions are missing. Restoring the database alone cannot recreate servers. Perform a complete backup after cluster connectivity recovers:
dbbackup_fix_hint: Without a valid database backup, host failure may prevent recovery of accounts, server ownership, and archive indexes. Run a daily backup on the host and inspect the timer logs:
dbbackup_offsite_note: Backups are stored only on the current host. Disk or host failure may affect both backups and original data. Copy backups regularly to an independent host. Restoration and disaster recovery procedures are documented in troubleshooting §16.
versions_subtitle: felis-update-check.timer compares installed component versions with upstream releases daily. Felis does not apply updates automatically.
versions_apply_hint: Run this read-only check on the host. It shows the target, scope and an exact `--apply` command. Review it, then run that command during the maintenance window:
versions_stale_title: The newest version check is more than {{hours}} hours old
versions_fix_hint: The displayed version information may be outdated. Run a new check on the host and inspect the timer logs to determine why the scheduled check did not run:
build_import_submission_more: Displaying the latest {{shown}} of {{total}} submissions. Use search to locate older submissions.
build_import_search_placeholder: Search submissions by name, ID or submitter
build_import_submission_hint: Selecting a submission automatically populates the Image Reference, Context Reference, and the corresponding Dockerfile audit header.
build_import_submission_warning_desc: Manually triggering a build will not automatically mark this submission as approved, nor will it update its associated build status in the database. Use for emergency debugging or testing only.
users_subtitle: Manage platform user accounts, quotas, and sessions.
users_create_desc: Create a new platform account. Accounts are passwordless — the user signs in with an in-game /link bind code, or with email verification / a passkey once bound.
user_not_found_body: The account does not exist or has been deleted. Return to the user list and search again.
users_empty_hint: No users match the current filters.
users_role_locked_self: The current account’s role cannot be changed.
users_role_locked_owner: The Owner role cannot be changed. Manage it through the host recovery console (sudo felis breakGlass).
users_unlink_dlg_desc: Are you sure you want to unlink this Minecraft account? The user will lose any in-game identity tied to this UUID.
users_quota_hint: Leave blank for no limit. Zero allocates no resources for that category. Claims exceeding the quota are rejected. Reducing a quota restricts subsequent claims without affecting existing servers.
users_session_revoke_one_dlg_desc: Are you sure you want to revoke this session? The user will be logged out from this device immediately.
users_session_revoke_all_dlg_desc: Are you sure you want to revoke all active sessions? The user will be logged out from every device.
users_protected_self: The signed-in account cannot be disabled or deleted.
users_protected_owner: The Owner account cannot be disabled or deleted from the panel. Manage it through the host recovery console (sudo felis breakGlass).
users_danger_disable_desc: Prevent this user from logging in. All active sessions will be revoked immediately.
users_danger_enable_desc: Allow this user to log in again.
users_danger_disable_dlg_desc: This user will be unable to log in. All active sessions will be revoked immediately.
users_danger_enable_dlg_desc: This user will be able to log in again.
users_danger_delete_dlg_desc: This action is permanent. The user's owned servers will be released, all sessions revoked, and the account permanently disabled. This cannot be undone through the panel.
users_danger_delete_desc: Soft-delete this user. Owned servers are released, all sessions are revoked, and the account is permanently disabled. This action cannot be undone through the panel.
users_danger_passkeys_desc: Remove all Passkeys registered to this account to address lost or compromised authenticators. Other sign-in methods, including email codes and in-game approval, remain available.
users_danger_passkeys_dlg_desc: All Passkeys registered to this account will be permanently removed. Other sign-in methods remain available. Keys can be registered again from Account after sign-in.
add_image_desc: Register an external Docker image reference on the whitelist for later server creation.
search_no_results_hint: Try a different search term or filter.
trigger_build_desc: Enter the build parameters to launch a Kaniko pipeline job in an isolated namespace.
builds_search_placeholder: Search build ID, image reference, or status...
builds_refresh_failed: Unable to refresh the build list: {{reason}}
scan_none: This build has no retained security scan record. It may have ended before scanning or been created before scan retention was enabled.
scan_load_failed: Unable to load the security scan: {{reason}}
scan_policy: Blocks on {{severities}}; vulnerabilities with no fixed release are listed only
scan_policy_unfixed: Blocks on {{severities}}, including vulnerabilities with no fixed release
scan_clean: Trivy detected no findings in this image.
scan_showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} findings. The full report lists every one.
scan_policy_accepts_one: {{count}} ID accepted as a known risk
scan_accepted_title: Listed in [registry] scan_accept as a known risk, so it never blocks.
scan_not_kept: The file was not retained for this build. It may have exceeded the size limit or its generation step may have failed.
platform_subtitle: Global controls for server startup and wake requests.
platform_limit_hint: 0 means unlimited. New starts count servers already running or requested to run; system services can always start. Lowering the limit does not stop existing servers.
platform_cooldown_hint: Minimum interval between accepted wake requests for the same server. 0 disables the cooldown.
platform_scope: The limit applies to panel starts, in-game wakes and scheduled starts. It is an admission check; available memory still determines whether Kubernetes can schedule a server. User quotas remain under Users.
platform_saved: Saved. The new policy is active without a restart.
platform_live: Saved changes apply immediately on all API replicas.
platform_distribution_architecture: One controller runs the API, operator, database, registry, and public entry point. Multiple workers run game servers and maintenance tasks. Multiple controllers, controller high availability, and automatic failover are not supported.
platform_distribution_enable_hint: Enabling distributed mode requires installer configuration of controller identity, WireGuard, archive transport, and node isolation during a maintenance window. This deployment configuration cannot be switched live from the panel.
platform_distribution_prepare: Back up the database and k3s state, configure the controller using the deployment runbook, and update the complete peer address list on all existing nodes. Workers must use the same architecture and k3s version as the controller.
platform_distribution_token: On the controller, create a separate expiring bootstrap token for each worker as root. Transfer the token file over trusted SSH/SCP. Do not provide the server token or administrator kubeconfig to workers. Replace command placeholders with actual values.
platform_distribution_worker: Run felis node join on the worker using the runbook, supplying the controller address, fixed node address, token file, Registry address, and complete peer list. New nodes remain isolated with NoSchedule until approval.
platform_distribution_approve: Approve the node from the controller. The command verifies identity, network isolation, image pulling, and cross-node connectivity. Failed checks preserve isolation. Approval removes the specified cached image and must run before the node hosts game workloads.
platform_distribution_management: Online approved workers can be selected when creating a server. Existing servers must be fully stopped before migration. Successful migration leaves the server stopped and retains its source world volume.
